sections.heading: Is Forex4you Worth Your Money in 2026?
sections.body:
Seventeen years is a long time in retail forex. Most scam brokers collapse within three. Forex4you — also operating as Markets4you — launched in 2007 under the E-Global Trade & Finance Group umbrella and has maintained continuous operations since, primarily serving Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Africa. The Share4you copy trading platform is its standout feature: a social trading system where followers replicate leader strategies without managing trades themselves. Pro account pricing starts from 0.0 pips with a $6 round-turn commission, and Cent accounts let you test live conditions with as little as $1.

But here is what 17 years of operation has not produced: a single Tier-1 regulatory licence. No FCA. No ASIC. No CySEC. The BVI FSC licence (SIBA/L/12/1027) is the only regulation Forex4you has ever held — and the BVI does not offer investor compensation, does not guarantee fund segregation, and has no meaningful enforcement track record against forex brokers. That is not a neutral fact. It is a deliberate choice repeated every year for nearly two decades.

Forex4you suits copy trading followers in SE Asia who accept offshore risk for Share4you access, and absolute beginners testing with $1 on Cent accounts. Everyone else should ask: why not use a broker with identical pricing and actual regulatory protection?

sections.heading: Is Forex4you Regulated? — Licence Check 2026
sections.body:
Barely — in any meaningful sense. Forex4you is licenced by the British Virgin Islands Financial Services Commission under SIBA/L/12/1027, held by E-Global Trade & Finance Group, Inc. The BVI FSC is a regulatory body in the technical sense, but it does not operate anywhere near the standards of FCA, ASIC, or CySEC. There is no investor compensation fund. There is no guaranteed fund segregation requirement. The enforcement mechanism for retail forex disputes is effectively non-existent — you cannot file a complaint and expect the BVI to investigate the way AFCA or the FOS would.

What does this mean for your money? If Forex4you becomes insolvent tomorrow, there is no compensation scheme to recover your deposit. Your funds may or may not be held separately from company operating capital — the broker states they use segregated accounts, but no external regulator mandates or audits this. Under BVI regulation, leverage is uncapped — hence the 1:1000 offering. No negative balance protection is mandated by law, though the broker states it is provided.

The absence from any Tier-1 warning list is worth noting. Forex4you does not appear on FCA, ASIC, BaFin, CySEC, or IOSCO warning databases. That means no active fraud investigation — but it also means no Tier-1 regulator has ever endorsed or licenced this operation. NAFT last reviewed Forex4you regulation in May 2026.

sections.heading: How Fast Can You Get Your Money Out of Forex4you?
sections.body:
Deposits are instant via e-wallets (Neteller, Skrill, FasaPay) and card payments. Bank wire takes 2-5 business days depending on your local banking infrastructure — slower in Africa and South Asia, faster in Southeast Asia where local bank transfer options exist. No deposit fees on any method (broker-stated), and the $1 minimum on Cent accounts means you can test the full deposit-to-withdrawal cycle with negligible risk.

Withdrawals are where offshore brokers get tested. Forex4you states zero withdrawal fees and processing within 1-3 business days for most methods. E-wallets should process same-day or next business day. Card withdrawals typically take longer due to bank processing on the receiving end. The zero-fee policy is a genuine advantage — many offshore brokers charge $25-$50 per wire withdrawal, which traps small accounts.

The critical test: deposit $10-$50, trade minimally, and request a full withdrawal immediately. If it clears within the stated timeframe without friction, you have baseline confidence. If the broker asks for additional verification beyond standard KYC, or if the withdrawal stalls without clear communication — do not deposit more. That test costs you almost nothing and tells you everything about operational integrity.
